content.title: THE MINERAL YOUR {{THYROID}} CAN'T FUNCTION WITHOUT
facts: **Iodine** (Thyroid Fuel) — Cod | Seaweed Snacks | Shrimp | Dairy Milk
**Manganese** (Bone Builder) — Mussels | Brown Rice | Pineapple | Pecans
**Copper** (Energy Spark) — Beef Liver | Lentils | Cashews | Dark Leafy Greens
**Selenium** (Cell Defender) — Brazil Nuts | Tuna | Eggs | Sunflower Seeds
**Potassium** (Heart Rhythm Keeper) — Sweet Potato | Bananas | White Beans | Coconut Water
**Zinc** (Immune Shield) — Oysters | Chickpeas | Pumpkin Pie Filling | Turkey
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.

caption:
Your body only needs tiny amounts of these minerals, but skipping them shows up fast. Iodine is the raw material your thyroid uses to make the hormones that set your metabolism's pace — too little and everything from energy to body temperature slows down. Selenium works like a bodyguard for your cells, helping clear out oxidative damage before it builds up, which is part of why Brazil nuts get so much attention (just 1-2 a day already covers your needs). Copper quietly helps your body absorb and use the iron you eat, so even with enough iron in your diet, low copper can still leave you feeling drained. Everyone's body is different, so pay attention to how yours responds.
